De voorzitter verdeelt de spreektijd per: The chair divides the speaking time per agenda item among the groups. A member speaks at most five minutes in the first round, at most three minutes in the second.
Volgende versie gaat in op 1 januari 202: The next version takes effect on 1 January 2027 if the council decides on 15 October.
